_comment: Policies the reference tenant can't hold, usually because the licence isn't available in a developer tenant. The nightly export leaves these files alone and the pipeline skips them; the deployer site deploys them to customers as normal. They have not been validated in the reference tenant.

files.reason: Endpoint Privilege Management needs Microsoft 365 E5 (or the Intune Suite / EPM add-on); not available in the developer tenant
